description:
## Background

Issue Detail currently lives inside `src/issues/IssueExplorer.tsx`, alongside Issue List rendering and list-specific route assumptions. Graph Mode must show the same detail content in a nonmodal overlay. Copying that implementation would create a second view model, Markdown renderer, Issue Reference behavior, deep-link action, and not-found presentation that would drift from List mode.

This is a behavior-preserving prefactor that makes the later Graph slice easy without changing routes or visuals.

Triage: ready-for-agent.

## What to build

Extract the existing Issue Detail presentation behind a reusable component interface, then keep the current Issue Explorer rendering it exactly as before. The reusable surface must own the complete selected, empty, and not-found presentations and allow its caller to supply navigation actions without assuming that every reference targets an Issue List route.

## Technical Approach

- Move the Issue Detail presentation and its directly owned rendering helpers out of `IssueExplorer.tsx` into a focused module.
- Preserve status, priority, type, labels, parent, dependencies, Child Issues, description Markdown, comments, other metadata, copy-deep-link feedback, scroll, and focus behavior.
- Replace List-specific route construction inside nested reference and Child Issue components with a deep navigation callback or destination interface supplied by the caller.
- Keep the existing Issue Explorer responsible for resolving the selected Issue from `allIssues`, deriving children, and supplying List-mode navigation.
- Preserve external-link opening and Markdown font-size configuration.
- Move or reorganize tests only where necessary to keep the reusable component covered through its public interface; do not duplicate the existing 2,000-plus-line suite.

## Considerations

- This issue must not add Graph UI, Graph routes, new state, or a second Issue model.
- Modified link activation and ordinary anchor semantics must remain intact.
- The selected Issue can be outside the active Issue List View; detail must continue resolving from `allIssues`.
- Changing Issue selection must retain the established focus and scroll-reset behavior.
- Keep the refactor narrow even though the source file is large.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Issue Detail is exported from a focused reusable module with no dependency on an Issue List-only route shape.
- [ ] Issue Explorer uses the extracted presentation with no user-visible layout, copy, focus, scroll, or navigation changes.
- [ ] Parent, dependency, and Child Issue references still preserve the active List view and search when used from List mode.
- [ ] Empty, selected, and missing-Issue presentations remain covered.
- [ ] Markdown, comments, metadata, deep-link copying, and external links retain existing behavior.
- [ ] No Graph-specific behavior or duplicate detail implementation is introduced.
- [ ] `mise run doctor:react` and `mise run verify` pass.

## Test Plan

- Focused component tests for selected, empty, and not-found detail states.
- Regression coverage for parent, dependency, and Child Issue navigation callbacks.
- Preserve the existing IssueExplorer tests for view/search-independent selection, focus, scroll, Markdown, comments, and deep-link copying.
- Run the canonical `mise run verify` gate.
title: Extract the reusable Issue Detail presentation
